name: GORY.OU.SHI.N
source:
Irae Sakura is young, lonely, yet excitable girl starting her life at a new school. When she meets two older students, Ren and Emi, she finally feels like she belongs. 

Together, they explore the school, eat lunch under the windows, and make plans for the upcoming culture festival. Irae has never been happier.

But something is wrong.
But something is wrong.
But something is wrong
But something is wrong.
But something is wrong
